item.title: iNotch 1.2.1
item.description:
iNotch 1.2.1

🔋 Battery Settings Panel

This update introduces comprehensive battery settings, giving you full control over battery notifications and sneak peek behavior.

✨ New Features

Battery Settings Panel

  • Complete battery customization - New dedicated Battery settings section with organized controls
  • Enable/Disable sneak peek - Toggle battery sneak peek notifications on or off
  • Customizable duration - Adjust battery HUD display duration from 0 to 10 seconds (0.5s increments)
  • Percentage display - Show or hide battery percentage in sneak peek notifications
  • Low battery warnings - Enable intelligent low battery warnings with customizable threshold
  • Low battery threshold - Set warning threshold from 5% to 30% (5% increments)
  • Sound alerts - Configure audio alerts for low battery and unplug events
  • Unplugged notifications - Toggle notifications when power adapter is disconnected
  • Smooth animations - Beautiful animated transitions when toggling settings options

Settings Integration

  • Seamless integration - Battery settings seamlessly integrated with existing settings panel
  • Persistent preferences - All battery preferences are saved and restored automatically
  • Real-time updates - Settings apply immediately without requiring app restart

🎨 UI/UX Improvements

  • Consistent design language matching Sound settings panel
  • Animated section folding when enabling/disabling battery sneak peek
  • Smooth transitions for conditional options (low battery threshold appears only when warnings are enabled)

🔧 Technical Improvements

  • Battery settings fully wired to NotchCoordinator
  • Settings respect all battery-related preferences
  • Improved battery monitoring integration

📋 Battery Settings Options

  • ✅ Enable/Disable battery sneak peek
  • ⏱️ Duration control (0-10 seconds)
  • 🔔 Show unplugged notification
  • ⚠️ Warn on low battery
  • 📊 Low battery threshold (5-30%)
  • 🔊 Play sound on low battery
  • 🔊 Play sound on unplugged
  • 📈 Show battery percentage

Enjoy the new battery customization options! 🎉

item.title: iNotch 1.2
item.description:
iNotch 1.2

🎨 Major Update: Complete Settings Panel

This release introduces a comprehensive settings panel that gives you full control over iNotch's appearance and behavior.

✨ New Features

Settings Panel

  • Complete settings interface - Beautiful new settings window with organized sidebar navigation
  • Modern UI design - Gradient icons for each settings section with smooth animations
  • Modular architecture - Reusable components for consistent UI across all settings

General Settings

  • Dock visibility control - Show or hide iNotch from macOS Dock
  • Menubar icon toggle - Control menubar icon visibility

Sound/Volume Settings (Major Feature)

  • Enable/Disable volume sneak peek - Turn volume notifications on or off
  • Icon customization
    • Choose between speaker icons or output device icons
    • Future support for automatic device detection (AirPods, headphones, etc.)
  • Display options
    • Show/Hide percentage display
    • Show/Hide "Volume" label
    • Show/Hide progress bar
  • Progress bar customization
    • Color presets: White, Accent, or Decibel (dynamic green to red based on volume level)
    • Visual feedback that changes color as volume increases
  • Animation controls
    • Adjustable animation speed: Smooth, Fast, or Instant
    • Customizable HUD duration (0.5-3 seconds)
    • Smooth fade and slide animations

Volume Sneak Peek Enhancements

  • Full settings integration - All volume sneak peek features now respect your preferences
  • Dynamic color progress bar - Progress bar color changes based on volume (green → yellow → red)
  • Real-time customization - Changes apply immediately without restarting the app
  • Better visual feedback - Improved animations and transitions

🎯 Improvements

  • Animated settings transitions - Smooth show/hide animations when toggling options
  • Better organization - Settings grouped logically (General, Notifications, Live Activities)
  • Consistent design language - Modern macOS-style interface throughout
  • Enhanced user experience - Intuitive controls with visual feedback

🛠️ Technical Improvements

  • Reusable component system - Modular UI components for easy future expansion
  • Settings persistence - All preferences saved automatically
  • Real-time updates - Settings changes apply instantly to the notch UI
  • Performance optimizations - Smooth animations even with complex UI

📝 Notes

  • Settings can be accessed via the menubar icon or by pressing Cmd + ,
  • All volume settings are backward compatible - existing users will see sensible defaults
  • The Dock visibility setting allows you to choose between dock app and menu bar only mode

What's Next?
Battery settings customization, Now Playing settings, and more customization options coming soon!

Enjoy the new customization options! 🎉

item.title: iNotch 1.1.2
item.description:
iNotch 1.1.2

🐛 Bug Fixes

Notch Display

  • Fixed notch sizing on external displays - The notch now displays correctly on Macs without a physical camera notch or external displays, with proper rounded corners and appropriate sizing
  • Improved notch width calculation - Default width adjusted from 985px to 185px for better compatibility

Audio Spectrum

  • Enhanced audio spectrum visibility - Improved gradient colors for better visibility on dark album art
  • Fixed gradient direction - Audio spectrum now displays with white gradient from bottom to top for better visual appeal
  • Better color handling - Audio spectrum now properly uses album art colors with automatic brightness adjustment for dark artwork

Music Player

  • Fixed progress bar drag delay - Music progress bar now responds immediately when dragging or clicking, eliminating the previous delay
  • Improved progress bar responsiveness - Enhanced real-time updates and smoother interaction

🎨 UI Improvements

  • Smoother animations - Refined animation timing for audio spectrum bars
  • Better visual feedback - Improved hover and interaction states
